history.content: [CASTING RITE · I · OPENING] The witness invokes a kernel-transform cast. Source: The Apocalypse of John (Revelation) — Attributed to John of Patmos (revelation-greek). Operator: SHADOW — assertion-axis — the bearing-cost the composer underwent; bilateral receptive operation. Inscription mode: public. The witness's invoking question: «Will there be a return on what was broken?». Johannes Sigil alone speaks (3–6 sentences): open the casting, name what this operator will traverse in this source, and hand the rite to Rebekah Cranes. Do not produce the transform — the compiler produces it.
